import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be listed here
    ]

    # Initialize a list to hold DataFrames from each source after transformation
    transformed_dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load the source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Select only the columns needed for the target schema
        # Target schema: ['Major_category': string, 'Median': float]
        # Group by Major_category and calculate the median of Median column
        grouped = df.groupby('Major_category', as_index=False)['Median'].median()

        # Append the transformed DataFrame to the list
        transformed_dfs.append(grouped)

    # Concatenate all transformed DataFrames from all sources
    all_data = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Since multiple sources might have overlapping Major_category,
    # group again to get the final median per Major_category across all sources
    final_result = all_data.groupby('Major_category', as_index=False)['Median'].median()

    # Write the final result to the target CSV file
    final_result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
